title: A definer view whose body runs SQL of its own is reported as a gap, not scanned clean

expect.note: `query_to_xml` carries its query in a string, so the relations it reaches are unknowable here — the reach is proven and its far end is not
the half the analysis *could* read is still graded: taint suppresses nothing that was proven

fix: Rewrite the body so the relations it reads are visible statically — a plain sub-select instead of `query_to_xml` — or satisfy yourself that what it returns is safe to serve corpus_anon. The gap is in what the audit could see, not proof of a leak, so nothing here justifies a revoke.
